scope: Decide only whether the current segmental identity G40=/y/ remains distinct from G16=/j/. Do not decide syllabification, stress, diphthongs, allophony, romanization redesign, DAYI semantics or L03 curriculum in this gate.
evidence: @hnk/glyphs currently assigns G40=/y/ and G16=/j/ as distinct segmental values.
FROZEN SARADAYA and TAYOVAN contain G40/Y-bearing sequences; changing G40 would reinterpret stable lexical material.
DAYI is G19 G01 G40 G03 and therefore segmentally /d a y i/ under current authority.

AUTH-007 HOYU generation metadata is stale because an older artifact treated Y as consonantal /j/; that stale artifact is evidence of metadata debt, not evidence that current G40 should silently become /j/.
No governed allophonic rule has been recovered that merges /y/ and /j/.

options.description: Keep G40=/y/ as a vowel and G16=/j/ as a distinct glide/consonantal approximant. Preserve existing glyph authority; defer all word-level realization questions to B2-B4 and romanization coverage to B5.
options.effect: No canonical phoneme mutation; establishes B2-B5 may proceed from the existing distinction.

options.description: Do not affirm G40=/y/ yet. Open a separate evidence/design proposal for possible G40 reassignment. No reassignment occurs under B1 itself.
options.effect: Blocks B2-B6, DAYI pronunciation and HOYU repair until a new segmental proposal is reviewed.
